summary: Skip presence source bookkeeping before its first installation

replay.detail: No canonical projection or replay change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or admission rule change.

compatibility.detail: The never-installed producer uses one atomic installation check under its existing memory lock; after first installation all source scope, revision and acknowledgement checks remain active even after uninstall.

manual.detail: No new action or opt-in flag.

recovery.detail: Installation is serialized with accepted memory writes; existing failure fencing and reinstall behavior remain enforced.
